summary.en: The problem as open review items: a two-line headline lettered on its construction lines, a bus feeding 2–4 boxes of key and value, each with an amber revision triangle, one phrase underlined in amber.
summary.zh: 把问题画成未决的评审项：两行标题沿构造线写出，一条母线分出 2–4 个“键 + 值”方框，每个带一枚琥珀色修订三角，第二行的一个短语下划琥珀色波浪线。

fits: The opening sheet of a blueprint film: what is wrong today, as items a reviewer has marked.
notFor: Problems that are not a list of facts; more than four items; a reviewer who is not a person (the amber means one).

intent.en: State the problem the way a reviewer would: as open items on the drawing, each flagged by a person.
intent.zh: 像评审人那样陈述问题：画在图上的未决项，每项都被人标出。

content.en: Label, two headline lines (≤ 22 chars), a phrase of line 2 to underline, 2–4 key/value items (≤ 12 / 11), a note.
content.zh: 标签、两行标题（每行 ≤ 9 字）、第二行里要下划线的短语、2–4 个键值项（≤ 5 / 5 字）、一行注。

fits.zh: blueprint 片子的开场：今天哪里不对，画成评审人标出的条目。

notFor.zh: 不是事实清单的问题；超过四项；评审人不是人（琥珀色代表人）。

pairs.note: the claim sheet after it (route-pan right)

en: The mark must be a substring of line 2 exactly; in Chinese mark whole words, the underline follows the measured characters.
zh: mark 必须与第二行里的文字完全一致；中文请标整词，下划线按实测字宽画。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
